# cJSON

Unmodified copy of cJSON v1.7.18 (MIT, see `LICENSE`) from
https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/v1.7.18 — `cJSON.c`, `cJSON.h`
and `LICENSE`. LibVIO builds it with hidden symbol visibility, so
`libvio.so` does not export any `cJSON_*` symbol.
